text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Symboli Kris S's interview. 
Once things settled down a bit, a photo 
shoot in her racing outfit was held.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's quite commanding. Just what 
you'd expect from a member of the Symboli 
family.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And the color of that outfit— that's 
truly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Her racing silks are receiving great 
acclaim from the press as well. Watching 
this unfold brought back memories of all 
the trial and error that went into 
creating them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……。――No Idea.
choice_data_list:
...Is it about the design of the racing 
outfit?

...Is it about the design of the racing 
outfit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Concrete preference proposals—still 
none.
choice_data_list:
Is there anything you want to use as a 
motif?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ ――Nothing comes to mind.
choice_data_list:
Any specific requests for colors, 
decorations, or details...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ ――I don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...An answer didn't seem likely anytime 
soon. For now, I decided to think it over 
while browsing through the apparel shops 
in town.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—These clothes are... good. Many... 
pockets. They don't restrict... movement 
either. —Suitable clothes... for work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: How do you pick out your casual clothes?
How do you pick out your casual clothes?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Functionality. —That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We visited more shops after that, but— no 
concrete ideas had come to mind yet.
choice_data_list:
Maybe leaving the design to a professional 
is an option too...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I trust the designer's sense. ...However, 
I want to avoid leaving it entirely to 
others.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Racing silks are... the attire meant for 
fulfilling... one's mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—An outfit carrying... the honor of the 
Symboli name. I want to find... the answer 
myself.
choice_data_list:
Just pour all those feelings directly into 
your racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Feelings...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Symboli Kris S was lost in 
thought, an Umamusume appeared on the 
giant street monitor mounted on the 
building.

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
As one of the nation's most prestigious 
families, the Symboli household continues 
to lead the Japanese racing world to this 
day.

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
Today, let us delve into the history of 
that family— and the secret behind their 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—A documentary covering... the main 
family...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ! Is that... Master...!?

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
—The Japanese racing world has yet to 
reach a level where it can truly compete 
globally.

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
Taking the initiative to change the racing 
world. Creating a new whirlwind. I believe 
that is a vital duty for a family called 
prestigious.

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
"We are currently planting the seeds for 
that future, little by little—step by 
step."

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
"—Among them... is a girl who is just 
beginning to sprout here in Japan."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. Master hasn't changed a bit 
since that time. Not in the slightest—from 
what he determined to be his mission.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...The same applies to me. In that 
case... what attire should I don here in 
Japan—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. It seems... I have found the 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—No. It was within me—from the very 
beginning."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Allow me to declare one thing here and 
now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—In the past, I... was deeply indebted... 
to the Symboli family. I am grateful... 
for the opportunity to repay it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The green that symbolizes the Symboli 
family. Bearing it upon my shoulders... I 
will spark a revolution in the Japanese 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is—my mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
âSpeaking eloquentlyâlike Rudolf 
doesâis difficult.
choice_data_list: No, that was a magnificent declaration!
No, that was a magnificent declaration!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. In that case—that's good.
choice_data_list:
You really feel like a member of the clan 
in both name and deed.

You really feel like a member of the clan 
in both name and deed.
I'll keep helping you repay the favor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. In that case—that's good.
choice_data_list:
You really feel like a member of the clan 
in both name and deed.

You really feel like a member of the clan 
in both name and deed.
I'll keep helping you repay the favor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—It's thanks to thinking it through... 
with you, Trainer. It turned out to be... 
a fine racing outfit.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
However—this is where it begins. With my 
running— I will prove—that I am worthy of 
this outfit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I shall fulfill my mission. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...To wear this color... is to bear the 
honor... of the Symboli family."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—A burden... I don't think so, but... 
Partner... having you there... gives me 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...I'm counting on you.
